identity.description: Ecwid by Lightspeed: hosted ecommerce platform (online store builder). Its public REST API is documented on docs.ecwid.com (api-docs.ecwid.com now redirects there).
identity.identity_notes: Search results and the docs site identify the product as Ecwid by Lightspeed. api-docs.ecwid.com/reference/access-ecwid-api and /reference/access-tokens both 302-redirect to docs.ecwid.com. Verification is partial: the Lightspeed branding comes from search titles, not a fetched page.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0 for public apps. The changelog says the OAuth GET request type changed to POST for public apps (title only, not fetched).
auth.scopes_notes: Not established. Scope list not retrieved.

access.production_restrictions: Public apps must pass app validation before publishing to the App Market. Start with a Request form to Ecwid, then app validation, then listing. Private (custom) apps cannot be installed in other stores or become paid and published. Test credentials need a paid-plan store, or a free test store on a Premium plan obtained through an approved Request form.

read_ops: Read store orders, customers, products, settings, discounts
write_ops: Create, update, and delete items in the store
api.limitations: Only stores on paid plans can access the API. Webhooks and the Payment API need an external endpoint hosted by the app developer. Not verified: rate limits, SDK list, and the exact webhook event list. Some third-party descriptions of the API may be out of date, so check docs.ecwid.com directly.
